question: What Speed Limit (R2-1) sign sizes are shown in Table 2B-1 for conventional single-lane, conventional multi-lane, expressway, and freeway applications?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2B-1 (Regulatory Sign and Plaque Sizes, Sheet 1 of 6) lists the Speed Limit (R2-1) sign, referenced to Section 2B.21, with the following sizes (width x height, in inches): 24 x 30 for single-lane conventional roads, 30 x 36 for multi-lane conventional roads, 36 x 48 for expressways, and 48 x 60 for freeways. The table also shows a Minimum size of 18 x 24 and an Oversized size of 30 x 36. Standards (mandatory): - "The Speed Limit (R2-1) sign (see Figure 2B-3) shall display the limit established by law, ordinance, regulation, or as adopted by the authorized agency based on an engineering study. The speed limits displayed shall be in multiples of 5 mph." (Context: this is the sign to which the Table 2B-1 sizes apply.) Options (permitted): - Per the notes accompanying the sizing tables, larger signs may be used when appropriate (dimensions are shown as width x height, in inches). Visual evidence: - [Image 5] shows Table 2B-1 (Sheet 1 of 6) with the Speed Limit (R2-1) row, Section 2B.21: Single Lane 24 x 30; Multi-Lane 30 x 36; Expressway 36 x 48; Freeway 48 x 60; Minimum 18 x 24; Oversized 30 x 36. - [Image 1] shows Figure 2B-3 with the R2-1 Speed Limit sign design and its related plaques (R2-2P, R2-2aP, R2-3P, etc.), which the sizes in Table 2B-1 apply to. - [Image 4] shows Table 6G-1 (temporary traffic control zones), where the R2-1 sign is listed separately as 24 x 30 for conventional roads and 36 x 48 for freeway or expressway — a different (work-zone) sizing table, not Table 2B-1. - [Image 2] shows Table 7B-1, where the Speed Limit sign for school use (R2-1) is 24 x 30 (conventional road) with a 36 x 48 oversized option — again a distinct application, not Table 2B-1. Citations: - Page 109 - Section 2B.21 Standard §13 (p.85) - Figure 2B-3 (p.86) - Table 6G-1 (p.796) - Table 7B-1 (p.971)
gold_answer: 24 x 30, 30 x 36, 36 x 48, and 48 x 60 inches, respectively.
